verdict.rationale: Asana's own app components let developers plug app UI directly into the Asana interface, which is a native-feeling extension surface. However, the docs limit this to the surface of tasks and rules; nothing in the evidence describes custom views or dashboard widgets. missing for 10: documented custom view/project view extensibility, dashboard or reporting widget surfaces, design/styling guidance for native look-and-feel, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product

citations.quote: Plug your app directly into the Asana UI with app components. Build app components on the surface of tasks or rules so that customers can use their favorite tools and stay in flow.
publishing the REST API spec (./defs/asana_oas.yaml) and app components spec (./defs/app_components_oas.yaml)
